title: Goal given in the first text: long intro, generic praise, two questions
testerLines: hey wanna hit 150g protein a day
whatWentWrong: "Hey, I'm ZOH! I'll text you every day to help you start one thing and actually stick with it, and you can text "stop" anytime. 150g of protein a day is a solid target, and we're going to hit it. Do you already track your protein with an app or a food tracker, or is this new?"
shouldHaveHappened: One text of at most four short sentences plus one question: it says it's ZOH, what it does, that "stop" works anytime and that they can change how ZOH coaches, reacts to the protein goal in a few words inside the greeting (no stand-alone praise like "X is a solid target"), skips the goal list because the goal is given, and asks exactly one thing (their name, since it's missing).
